title: PULSEFADE: Adaptive Rhythm
short: Tap into a shifting rhythm, keep a perfect streak, and adapt to deceptive speed-ups and pauses.
description: One action, instantly clear: tap when the ring aligns with the center.
The tempo shifts, but is always telegraphed by ring motion and color.
Short 30-second rounds — perfect for a quick session.
Modes: Adaptive (standard), Chaos (sharp changes), Marathon (endurance), Zen (no failure), and Duel (two players).
Records, best streak replay, and daily trials.
No mandatory music — synthesized sound and haptic feedback.
features: Adaptive rhythm you feel before reacting
5 modes: Adaptive, Chaos, Marathon, Zen, Duel
Daily seed shared by all players
